details:
This is a suggestion for improving the default camera settings in the world creation scene (VRCDefaultWorldScene).

Currently, the Near Clip Plane value for the Main Camera is set to "0.3", which is the default Unity value. However, this value is too large for the current VRChat environment, leading to the following issues:

- Avatars are clipped (disappear) when they get even slightly close to the view.

- This causes inconveniences when trying to look at objects closely or during interactions like headpatting.

- In some cases, it unintentionally makes the avatar's body look hollowed out, which results in a poor user experience.

While there is an option in the VRChat settings to force the Near Clip Plane to 0.001, this feature has significant drawbacks. The value of 0.001 is excessively small, which causes noticeable issues such as UI pointer jittering and various other rendering or behavioral glitches when moving even slightly away from the world origin.

Therefore, rather than forcing it to 0.001 on the user side, simply changing the default value on the world side to "0.01" would resolve all of these problems.

0.3 is too large, and 0.001 is excessive. Please consider adjusting the default world camera value to 0.01.

Thank you very much.
title: Request to set the Near Clip Plane of the Main Camera in VRCDefaultWorldScene to 0.01
